$comment: The grammar leg's skip register: parse-kind cases whose rejection lives outside the grammar layer's reach. EMPTY as of suite 3.10.0 — the per-construct typed surface in grammar/primmel.parg (the dispatch, the required-value badness predicates, the closed facet vocabularies, the scoped sub-block dispatch with sub-keyword-excluded bares) carries the kernel's per-construct parse discipline for every corpus case. The register only shrinks and may only be repopulated with a reason a future case proves; the leg errors on a stale entry (a case that agrees without the skip), on an entry naming a case that no longer exists, and on a disagreement whose case is not registered.
